programs.title: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua
programs.desc: "The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics; based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

programs.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: The Podcast
programs.sub_title: Melinda French Gates on Leading With Integrity
programs.desc: Melinda French Gates discusses transitioning to a different path, practicing values-based leadership and handling public scrutiny.

programs.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: The Podcast
programs.sub_title: HSBC CEO Georges Elhedery on Leadership, AI and the Future of Global Banking
programs.desc: HSBC CEO Georges Elhedery joins Francine Lacqua to explain why he is ruthless about killing complexity as he pushes through an AI-fuelled overhaul of one of the world's biggest banks. He reflects on leadership, integrity and cultural fluency, and shares how HSBC is adapting to geopolitical tensions, shifting trade routes and the rapid rise of generative AI.

programs.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: The Podcast
programs.sub_title: Wael Sawan on Leading Shell: Control What You Can Amid Global Uncertainty
programs.desc: Shell Chief Executive Officer Wael Sawan joins Francine Lacqua to discuss the oil major's controversial strategy around the energy transition, and fostering a culture that shifts from all-knowing to all-learning. He reflects on navigating volatility in the global energy system, emphasizing disciplined decision-making and focusing on what leaders can influence going forward.

programs.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: The Podcast
programs.sub_title: Emma Grede: How She Built Good American and Helped Grow Skims
programs.desc: Francine Lacqua speaks with Emma Grede, chief executive and co-founder of Good American and founding partner of Skims; they discuss leading with radical honesty, hiring flexible talent for different stages of growth and why failure, directness and self-belief are essential to scaling a business; she also opens up about stepping into the spotlight and shares her views on work from home, modern leadership and the role of artificial intelligence in retail.

programs.title: The Deal With Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly
programs.sub_title: How NFL Legend Steve Young Built a $10 Billion Fund
programs.desc: Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly speak with Steve Young about his journey from NFL stardom to managing a $10 billion fund, discussing the challenges and lessons learned along the way.
